entities.name: Extended EPS QoS
entities.description: Information element that allows UE to transmit maximum and guaranteed bit rate values to the network when values exceed the maximum specified in the EPS QoS IE.

entities.name: EPS QoS
entities.description: EPS quality of service information element defined in clause 9.9.4.3 that specifies maximum bit rate values.

entities.name: QoS values exceed maximum
entities.description: Condition where at least one of the maximum or guaranteed bit rate values to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the EPS QoS IE.

entities.name: UE wishes to transmit QoS values
entities.description: Condition where the UE wishes to transmit maximum and guaranteed bit rate values to the network.

relations.description: Extended EPS QoS IE inclusion is guarded by the condition that UE wishes to transmit QoS values.
Extended EPS QoS IE inclusion is guarded by the condition that QoS values exceed maximum specified in EPS QoS IE.
The condition of QoS values exceeding maximum is defined relative to the maximum values specified in the EPS QoS IE.
